images.title: 1. Tubo horizontal para saltar
images.subject: ONE low industrial pipe hurdle, 2.2 meters wide and 0.85 meter high. A sturdy thick horizontal galvanized steel tube supported by two short vertical pipe legs with rounded elbow joints, each attached to a small rectangular bolted steel base foot. Tube diameter about 9 cm. Dull gray metal with realistic modest wear, small chipped mustard-yellow painted safety bands near both ends. Broad stable feet, central space under the bar open for a slide-under or jumping/vaulting obstacle. Pipe bar ends are smoothly capped. No sharp protrusions in the body contact area. Square canvas.

images.title: 2. Pasarela de tablones
images.subject: ONE narrow modular wooden plank bridge/deck, 2.8 meters long, 0.75 meter wide and approximately 12 cm thick, for spanning rooftop gaps or balancing across supports. Three thick parallel aged wooden planks joined into a single stable deck with two stout timber cross-braces underneath and small flush steel joining plates. Warm faded tan-brown timber, visible grain, believable worn edges and discreet screw heads. Ends square and intact, no dangerous spikes, no railing, no legs, no buildings or gap. View angled diagonally so both full ends and the three-board top are clearly readable. Square canvas.

images.title: 3. Obstáculo de neumáticos

Each tire is a realistic hollow torus with visible tread blocks and sidewalls; open circular center visible through the upper tire. Subtle rubber scuffs and dusty gray wear, no wheel rims, no metal hubs, no graffiti, no branding. The stack is upright and balanced, slight natural misalignment only. Three-quarter view showing the top hole, tread and full base of bottom tire. Square canvas.

images.title: 4. Rampa de parkour
images.subject: ONE practical straight wedge-shaped portable parkour ramp, 2.7 meters long, 1.3 meters wide, 0.85 meter high at the tall end. A continuous flat inclined plywood running surface on a robust gray steel triangular support frame with cross-bracing. Low front edge flush to ground, gradual straight slope ending at a short flat top lip suitable for a jump takeoff. Weathered brown plywood with non-slip grip texture, narrow worn mustard-yellow safety strips along the two side edges, realistic flush screws. No curved skate half-pipe, no handrails, no steps, no separate platforms. Show the inclined running surface and open triangular side frame clearly in a three-quarter diagonal view. Square canvas.

images.title: 5. Tubo vertical de descenso
images.subject: ONE modular vertical firefighter-style slide pole for descending a building facade, 3.5 meters tall and about 8 cm diameter. A perfectly straight smooth satin stainless-steel pole, with clean rounded end caps and two short substantial rearward-offset mounting arms, one very near the top and one very near the bottom, each ending in a flat wall mounting plate with bolt holes. Mounting arms are entirely BEHIND the pole, leaving the front and sides of the long central sliding surface clear for hands and legs. Restrained mustard-yellow paint only on the wall mounting plates; the entire graspable and sliding shaft stays smooth silver-gray, uninterrupted by ridges, collars, bolts or grips. No ladder rungs, no horizontal bars across the sliding area, no building or wall, no ground base, no person. Full object head to bottom entirely visible with both rear brackets, upright portrait 2:3 canvas, close enough to clearly see the pole and practical brackets.
